text:
The sympathetic innervation for the colon and distal GI tract involved in this patient's IBS originates from preganglionic neurons in the lateral horn of the thoracolumbar spinal cord, specifically T10–L2. The note claiming lumbosacral origin is incorrect for sympathetic supply; lumbosacral segments provide parasympathetic innervation to the distal gut.
CONFIDENCE: 95
